consequence.statement: The Envoy policy-map version metric is reported as `envoy_cilium_npds_version` instead of `envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_version`, so queries that use the old name need to be updated.
consequence.remediation: Update dashboards, alerts and recording rules that use `envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_version` to use `envoy_cilium_npds_version`.

original.statement: In Cilium 1.17 the Envoy metric `envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_version` is renamed to `envoy_cilium_npds_version`, so monitoring that uses the old name needs to be checked.

decision.reason: [ev-a70b049ef951] and [ev-77f05428497a] say the Envoy NPDS metric prefix has been renamed from `envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_` to `envoy_cilium_npds_`. This means the version metric is now reported under `envoy_cilium_npds_version`. The evidence lists this under 'Changed Metrics' but does not say that anything fails, is rejected or stops being honoured. A low-severity behavior-change asking operators to review and update their queries is therefore the strongest consequence supported without over-claiming mandatory work.
